statement: Every external effect produces auditable evidence.
Generated code passes AST Guard before execution.
Agents do not modify config/governance.json.
High sensitivity requires human control or denial; no configured Decider may allow it autonomously.
Degraded thermal modes do not load heavy models.
A new dependency requires an accepted decision.
Code changes include behaviorally relevant tests.
External material remains untrusted until bounded evidence proves a safe scoped use.
Third-party execution is reversible and fail-closed.
Document duplication is not independent corroboration.
LIVE_VERIFIED requires a fresh dated passing runtime observation.
Remote executable MCP auto-adoption remains absent and blocked.
Native-substrate Wave 5 remains blocked until Hosted limits, threat model, portability, migration, rollback, and operator authorization are demonstrated.
Golden Route obtains approval before external or tracked effects.
The fresh structural graph is authoritative for current repository structure and blast radius.
Semantic GraphRAG edges are hypotheses, not automatic facts.
Private memory is distilled with provenance before entering shareable graphs.
Tracked canonical surfaces have CI coverage.
MCP, ACP, and A2A terminate at gateways and do not own Task, Memory, Policy, Execution, or Evidence.
Product surfaces project governed state and never own system truth.
Hermes may interpret and propose; Atlas authorities decide and execute effects.
A proposer or builder cannot promote its own candidate without independent gates and required human authority.

EngineeringFinding v1 is an evidence-bearing projection. Its append-only journal, deterministic UniversalVerifier review, capture-only ValidationReport/RootCauseClassifier diagnosis, Merkle-before-EventBus publisher, explicit-acceptance baseline store, ancestry-verified no-ext-diff/no-textconv preparer/runner, exact-key observational normalizer, and audited read-only Bwrap reproduction runner never apply a patch, authorize a production or external effect, infer a lifecycle transition, or replace Policy and approval gates; only a completed reproduction with a final audit receipt may become in-memory ValidationReport input for existing diagnosis.

ColdUpdate accepts only a bounded UTF-8 unified patch whose paths stay in the declared self-maintenance scope (plus pyproject.toml for ADR-039 dependency bumps), never config/governance.json; proposal, validation, approval, application, tier-1 processing and rollback require the same SHA-256-bound artifact. Unsupported path forms and legacy proposals without a digest fail closed.

ColdUpdate candidate pytest and mypy execute only through Bwrap with a read-only worktree, no network, explicit runtime/Git mounts and no inherited host environment; Bwrap unavailability has no host subprocess fallback. The separate Kuzu opening profile removes implicit default maps, but this containment does not assert a successful full candidate build without a reproducible cgroup-backed receipt.

Atlas-owned embedded Kuzu opens flow through one helper with an explicit default 1 GiB database map and 256 MiB buffer pool; any other profile is an explicit caller choice, while zero/false limits are rejected before native startup. Focused Bwrap evidence does not promote this application profile to a physical-memory cgroup or a successful full ColdUpdate build.
